title: Major U.S. Food Distribution Warehouse
summary: See how Airgain Lighthouse improved Verizon 5G coverage at a major distribution warehouse, delivering more than 13-fold faster uploads at one test location.
body_markdown:
A major U.S. food distribution warehouse experienced a challenging 5G coverage gap in its truck yard, where the large warehouse building obstructed the existing cellular signal. Weak connectivity limited the ability of returning delivery trucks to upload vehicle diagnostics, location information, and other operational data from onboard telematics systems.


Working with Airgain, wireless systems integrator CTS Mobility deployed the Lighthouse™ 5G Intelligent Node to extend existing Verizon 5G coverage into the affected area without building a new cellular site.


Field testing demonstrated significant improvements in cellular performance. At one measured location, **upload speeds increased more than 13-fold, from 2.47 Mbps to 32.8 Mbps** . The installation was completed in just one day, demonstrating a practical approach to improving connectivity in challenging logistics environments.
